instructions: Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

items.prompt: The sixty animals used weighed between 114 and 324 grams, and (19) ........ of them were male.
items.evidence: Individual octopuses ranged from 114 to 324 grams, and the sample of sixty animals included forty-two males and eighteen females.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the sample of sixty animals included forty-two males and eighteen females, so the answer is 'forty-two'.

revision.onceki_prompt: In the first stage of the study, some pairs were kept in tanks split by a (19) ........ , so each animal could watch its neighbour without ever touching or smelling it.
revision.ne_degisti: Eski cerceve boslugu tanimliyordu: 'so each animal could watch its neighbour without ever touching or smelling it' yan cumlesi seffafligin tanimidir, dolayisiyla cevabin AYIRT EDICI sozcugu ('transparent') pasajdan degil sorunun kendisinden okunuyordu; model ucunde de 'transparent barrier' verdi. Yeni cumle gorme boyutunu hic anmiyor ve grubu C/2'nin baska bir ayrintisiyla (komsu tanklar + su beslemelerinin tamamen ayri tutulmasi) tanimliyor. Yuzeydeki sezgi artik yanlis yone gidiyor: ayri su beslemesi koku engelini cagristirdigi icin okumadan tahmin eden cozucu opak/masif bir bolme dusunur. C/3'teki opak bolme grubu icin ne komsu tank ne ayri su beslemesi soyleniyor, o yuzden cevap hala tek.

yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Half the pairs sat in neighbouring tanks separated by a transparent divider, allowing them to see but not touch or smell each other, since the water supplies were kept fully separate.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Eski bosluk 'transparent divider' idi ve C paragrafinin ikinci cumlesine dayaniyordu. Bolmenin seffafligi kosulun tanimindan zorunlu olarak cikiyordu: iki hayvanin birbirini gorup dokunamamasi ancak seffaf bir bolmeyle olur, dolayisiyla kok tek basina okununca tek aday cikiyordu. Uc bagimsiz turun ucunde de pasajsiz dogru bilindi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk kalibin ucundan cikarilip kaynagin sectigi bir sayiya acildi: orneklemdeki erkek sayisi. Kirk iki rakami calismanin kendi verisi; disaridan bilinemez, cunku otuz ya da elli de esit olculude makuldu. Kanit ayni pasajda B paragrafinin 2. cumlesine tasindi ve o cumlede baska soru yok.

items.prompt: Each pair lived in its own tank measuring (20) ........ by one hundred by fifty centimetres, supplied with running seawater at a constant temperature.
items.evidence: Every pair was housed in its own tank, measuring sixty-five by one hundred by fifty centimetres and supplied with running seawater kept at a constant 24°C, so that any behavioural change could be attributed to the animals' experience of one another rather than to differences in their surroundings.
items.explanation: Paragraph B gives the tank size as sixty-five by one hundred by fifty centimetres, so the answer is 'sixty-five'.

revision.onceki_prompt: Once the animals began sharing a tank, one of each pair came to win most encounters, so that a (20) ........ took shape over the three days.
revision.ne_degisti: Eski cerceve 'one of each pair came to win most encounters, so that a ___ took shape' diyerek baskinlik siralamasinin tanimini veriyordu; boslugun BAS ADI ('hierarchy') bu yan cumleden zorunlu olarak cikiyordu. Yeni cumlede kazanma/ustunluk dili hic yok; bosluk D/3'un ikinci yarisina (temas ve murekkep puskurtmenin seyrelmesi) ve D/2'nin sure ayrintisina capalandi. Bos yuvaya artik anlamca farkli adaylar da uyuyor (mutual tolerance, familiarity, settled routine) ve yuzeydeki sezgi -- 'iliskiler yumusadi' -- bunlardan birine, yani yanlis cevaba goturur. %76'lik oran da sorudan cikarildi, cunku D/3'un tek sayisal ayrintisiydi.

yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Across these encounters a dominance hierarchy consistently emerged, with the stronger animal in each pair winning an average of seventy-six per cent of interactions, and physical contact and defensive ink-jetting both became less frequent as the three days went on and the pair grew more familiar with one another.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Eski bosluk 'dominance hierarchy' idi. Cerceve uc gunluk bulusmalari ve murekkep puskurtmenin seyrelmesini verdigi icin bosluga yalnizca baskinlik siralamasi oturuyordu; bas ad cumlenin anlamsal rolunce zorunluydu ve uc turda da pasajsiz dogru bilindi. Ayrica kanit cumlesi ayni testteki matching-headings 16 ve matching-features 25 ile paylasiliyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk calismanin sectigi bir olcuye acildi: tank boyutu. Altmis bes santimetre keyfi bir sayi, disaridan bilinemez. Kanit ayni pasajda B paragrafinin 3. cumlesine tasindi; boylece D paragrafinin 3. cumlesindeki uclu kanit cakismasi da cozuldu.

items.prompt: In half of the pairs the resident animal was given back the partner it already knew, a procedure the team called a (21) ........ .
items.evidence: In half the pairs, an octopus was reunited with the same partner it had lived alongside for three days, a "sham" switch.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says that in half the pairs an octopus was reunited with the same partner it had lived alongside, which the researchers call a 'sham' switch.

yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Reversals of dominance, in which the previously subordinate animal became the stronger one, occurred only when the pair consisted of two strangers, in eight of the twelve such pairings; no reversal of this kind was seen among reunited familiar pairs, and no ink was released by any octopus during this final test.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bu kalem isaretli degildi, ama iki butce kuralini birden bozuyordu: kaniti (F paragrafinin 4. cumlesi) matching-features 24 ile paylasiyordu ve F paragrafinda toplam dort soru birikmisti (matching-headings 18, matching-features 23, matching-features 24, bu kalem). F'deki oteki uc kalemin kaniti baska paragrafa tasinamaz, cunku baslik sorusu paragrafa, iki ozellik sorusu da yalnizca F'de anlatilan davranis karsilastirmasina bagli. Bu yuzden tasinacak tek kalem buydu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva ayni pasajda E paragrafinin 2. cumlesine tasindi ve bosluk calismanin kendi verdigi teknik ada acildi ('sham' switch). Ad keyfi bir etiket, disaridan bilinemez. Boylece F paragrafinin yuku uce indi, F/4'teki kanit cakismasi kapandi ve tamamlama kalemleri (19-B, 20-B, 21-E, 22-G) yeniden pasaj sirasina girdi; eskiden 21 F'de, 22 E'de olduğu icin sira bozuktu.

items.prompt: The authors say the animal does not identify a unique individual but only sorts others into "known" and "unknown", which they call (22) ........ , or binary, recognition.
items.evidence: The authors describe this as class-level, or binary, recognition: an octopus need not identify a unique individual by name, so to speak, only sort others into the broad categories of "known" and "unknown" and adjust its behaviour accordingly.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says the authors describe the ability as class-level, or binary, recognition, in which others are sorted into 'known' and 'unknown'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Each reunion again lasted fifteen minutes, and the same behaviours were recorded as in the earlier cohabitation phase.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Eski bosluk yedinci gun bulusmalarinin suresiydi ('fifteen minutes'), kanit E paragrafinin 4. cumlesiydi. Sure ayni pakette 20. kalemin cercevesinde zaten geciyordu ve cerceve 'again ran for ___' diyerek onceki asamaya gonderme yaptigi icin ayni deger ikinci kez okunuyordu; uc turda da pasajsiz dogru bilindi. Ayrica bu kalem E paragrafindaydi ve kendisinden onceki 21. kalem F paragrafindaydi, yani tamamlama dizisi pasaj sirasini bozuyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva ayni pasajda G paragrafinin 2. cumlesine tasindi. Bosluk yazarlarin kendi tercih ettigi terime aciliyor; 'binary' cercevede verilse de o terimin karsiligi tek bir bicimde adlandirilmis ve disaridan uretilemez. Kanit cumlesinde baska soru yok, G paragrafinin yuku bir.
